verdict.rationale: Pipedream workflows support inline Node.js (and Python/Go/Bash per GitHub) code steps between triggers/actions, letting ops users write custom expressions/functions to transform data, plus $.export for structured output passing between steps, and npm package access for complex transforms. Community feedback corroborates real-world use for building integration/transformation logic. missing for 10: no dedicated 'formula builder' or no-code expression UI evidence, and no first-party demonstration of a full multi-step data-mapping example.
